verses.en: Let brotherly love continue.
verses.pt: Permaneça o amor fraternal.
verses.en_web: Let brotherly love continue.
verses.en_bbe: Go on loving your brothers in the faith.

verses.en: Be not forgetful to entertain strangers: for thereby some have entertained angels unawares.
verses.pt: Não vos esqueçais da hospitalidade, porque por ela alguns, sem o saberem, hospedaram anjos.
verses.en_web: Don’t forget to show hospitality to strangers, for in doing so, some have entertained angels without knowing it.
verses.en_bbe: Take care to keep open house: because in this way some have had angels as their guests, without being conscious of it.

verses.en: Remember them that are in bonds, as bound with them; and them which suffer adversity, as being yourselves also in the body.
verses.pt: Lembrai-vos dos presos, como se estivésseis presos com eles, e dos maltratados, como sendo-o vós mesmos também no corpo.
verses.en_web: Remember those who are in bonds, as bound with them; and those who are ill-treated, since you are also in the body.
verses.en_bbe: Keep in mind those who are in chains, as if you were chained with them, and those who are in trouble, as being yourselves in the body.

verses.en: Marriage is honourable in all, and the bed undefiled: but whoremongers and adulterers God will judge.
verses.pt: Honrado seja entre todos o matrimônio e o leito sem mácula; pois aos devassos e adúlteros, Deus os julgará.
verses.en_web: Let marriage be held in honor among all, and let the bed be undefiled: but God will judge the sexually immoral and adulterers.
verses.en_bbe: Let married life be honoured among all of you and not made unclean; for men untrue in married life will be judged by God.

verses.en: Let your conversation be without covetousness; and be content with such things as ye have: for he hath said, I will never leave thee, nor forsake thee.
verses.pt: Seja a vossa vida isenta de ganância, contentando-vos com o que tendes; porque ele mesmo disse: Não te deixarei, nem te desampararei.
verses.en_web: Be free from the love of money, content with such things as you have, for he has said, “I will in no way leave you, neither will I in any way forsake you.”
verses.en_bbe: Be free from the love of money and pleased with the things which you have; for he himself has said, I will be with you at all times.

verses.en: So that we may boldly say, The Lord is my helper, and I will not fear what man shall do unto me.
verses.pt: De modo que com plena confiança digamos: O Senhor é quem me ajuda, não temerei; que me fará o homem?
verses.en_web: So that with good courage we say, “The Lord is my helper. I will not fear. What can man do to me?”
verses.en_bbe: So that we say with a good heart, The Lord is my helper; I will have no fear: what is man able to do to me?

verses.en: Remember them which have the rule over you, who have spoken unto you the word of God: whose faith follow, considering the end of their conversation.
verses.pt: Lembrai-vos dos vossos guias, os quais vos falaram a palavra de Deus, e, atentando para o êxito da sua carreira, imitai-lhes a fé.
verses.en_web: Remember your leaders, men who spoke to you the word of God, and considering the results of their conduct, imitate their faith.
verses.en_bbe: Keep in mind those who were over you, and who gave you the word of God; seeing the outcome of their way of life, let your faith be like theirs.

verses.en: Jesus Christ the same yesterday, and to day, and for ever.
verses.pt: Jesus Cristo é o mesmo, ontem, e hoje, e eternamente.
verses.en_web: Jesus Christ is the same yesterday, today, and forever.
verses.en_bbe: Jesus Christ is the same yesterday and today and for ever.

verses.en: Be not carried about with divers and strange doctrines. For it is a good thing that the heart be established with grace; not with meats, which have not profited them that have been occupied therein.
verses.pt: Não vos deixeis levar por doutrinas várias e estranhas; porque bom é que o coração se fortifique com a graça, e não com alimentos, que não trouxeram proveito algum aos que com eles se preocuparam.
verses.en_web: Don’t be carried away by various and strange teachings, for it is good that the heart be established by grace, not by food, through which those who were so occupied were not benefited.
verses.en_bbe: Do not be turned away by different strange teachings, because it is good for your hearts to be made strong by grace, and not by meats, which were of no profit to those who took so much trouble over them.

verses.en: We have an altar, whereof they have no right to eat which serve the tabernacle.
verses.pt: Temos um altar, do qual não têm direito de comer os que servem ao tabernáculo.
verses.en_web: We have an altar from which those who serve the holy tabernacle have no right to eat.
verses.en_bbe: We have an altar from which those priests who are servants in the Tent may not take food.

verses.en: For the bodies of those beasts, whose blood is brought into the sanctuary by the high priest for sin, are burned without the camp.
verses.pt: Porque os corpos dos animais, cujo sangue é trazido para dentro do santo lugar pelo sumo sacerdote como oferta pelo pecado, são queimados fora do arraial.
verses.en_web: For the bodies of those animals, whose blood is brought into the holy place by the high priest as an offering for sin, are burned outside of the camp.
verses.en_bbe: For the bodies of the beasts whose blood is taken into the holy place by the high priest as an offering for sin are burned outside the circle of the tents.

verses.en: Wherefore Jesus also, that he might sanctify the people with his own blood, suffered without the gate.
verses.pt: Por isso também Jesus, para santificar o povo pelo seu próprio sangue, sofreu fora da porta.
verses.en_web: Therefore Jesus also, that he might sanctify the people through his own blood, suffered outside of the gate.
verses.en_bbe: For this reason Jesus was put to death outside the walls, so that he might make the people holy by his blood.

verses.en: Let us go forth therefore unto him without the camp, bearing his reproach.
verses.pt: Saiamos pois a ele fora do arraial, levando o seu opróbrio.
verses.en_web: Let us therefore go out to him outside of the camp, bearing his reproach.
verses.en_bbe: Let us then go out to him outside the circle of the tents, taking his shame on ourselves.

verses.en: For here have we no continuing city, but we seek one to come.
verses.pt: Porque não temos aqui cidade permanente, mas buscamos a vindoura.
verses.en_web: For we don’t have here an enduring city, but we seek that which is to come.
verses.en_bbe: For here we have no fixed resting-place, but our search is for the one which is to come.

verses.en: By him therefore let us offer the sacrifice of praise to God continually, that is, the fruit of our lips giving thanks to his name.
verses.pt: Por ele, pois, ofereçamos sempre a Deus sacrifício de louvor, isto é, o fruto dos lábios que confessam o seu nome.
verses.en_web: Through him, then, let us offer up a sacrifice of praise to God continually, that is, the fruit of lips which proclaim allegiance to his name.
verses.en_bbe: Let us then make offerings of praise to God at all times through him, that is to say, the fruit of lips giving witness to his name.

verses.en: But to do good and to communicate forget not: for with such sacrifices God is well pleased.
verses.pt: Mas não vos esqueçais de fazer o bem e de repartir com outros, porque com tais sacrifícios Deus se agrada.
verses.en_web: But don’t forget to be doing good and sharing, for with such sacrifices God is well pleased.
verses.en_bbe: But go on doing good and giving to others, because God is well-pleased with such offerings.

verses.en: Obey them that have the rule over you, and submit yourselves: for they watch for your souls, as they that must give account, that they may do it with joy, and not with grief: for that is unprofitable for you.
verses.pt: Obedecei a vossos guias, sendo-lhes submissos; porque velam por vossas almas como quem há de prestar contas delas; para que o façam com alegria e não gemendo, porque isso não vos seria útil.
verses.en_web: Obey your leaders and submit to them, for they watch on behalf of your souls, as those who will give account, that they may do this with joy, and not with groaning, for that would be unprofitable for you.
verses.en_bbe: Give ear to those who are rulers over you, and do as they say: for they keep watch over your souls, ready to give an account of them; let them be able to do this with joy and not with grief, because that would be of no profit to you.

verses.en: Pray for us: for we trust we have a good conscience, in all things willing to live honestly.
verses.pt: Orai por nós, porque estamos persuadidos de que temos boa consciência, sendo desejosos de, em tudo, portar-nos corretamente.
verses.en_web: Pray for us, for we are persuaded that we have a good conscience, desiring to live honorably in all things.
verses.en_bbe: Make prayers for us, for we are certain that our hearts are free from the sense of sin, desiring the right way of life in all things.

verses.en: But I beseech you the rather to do this, that I may be restored to you the sooner.
verses.pt: E com instância vos exorto a que o façais, para que eu mais depressa vos seja restituído.
verses.en_web: I strongly urge you to do this, that I may be restored to you sooner.
verses.en_bbe: I make this request more strongly, in the hope of coming back to you more quickly.

verses.en: Now the God of peace, that brought again from the dead our Lord Jesus, that great shepherd of the sheep, through the blood of the everlasting covenant,
verses.pt: Ora, o Deus de paz, que pelo sangue do pacto eterno tornou a trazer dentre os mortos a nosso Senhor Jesus, grande pastor das ovelhas,
verses.en_web: Now may the God of peace, who brought again from the dead the great shepherd of the sheep with the blood of an eternal covenant, our Lord Jesus,
verses.en_bbe: Now may the God of peace, who made that great keeper of his flock, even our Lord Jesus, come back from the dead through the blood of the eternal agreement,

verses.en: Make you perfect in every good work to do his will, working in you that which is wellpleasing in his sight, through Jesus Christ; to whom be glory for ever and ever. Amen.
verses.pt: vos aperfeiçoe em toda boa obra, para fazerdes a sua vontade, operando em nós o que perante ele é agradável, por meio de Jesus Cristo, ao qual seja glória para todo o sempre. Amém.
verses.en_web: make you complete in every good work to do his will, working in you that which is well pleasing in his sight, through Jesus Christ, to whom be the glory forever and ever. Amen.
verses.en_bbe: Make you full of every good work and ready to do all his desires, working in us whatever is pleasing in his eyes through Jesus Christ; and may the glory be given to him for ever and ever. So be it.

verses.en: And I beseech you, brethren, suffer the word of exhortation: for I have written a letter unto you in few words.
verses.pt: Rogo-vos, porém, irmãos, que suporteis estas palavras de exortação, pois vos escrevi em poucas palavras.
verses.en_web: But I exhort you, brothers, endure the word of exhortation; for I have written to you in few words.
verses.en_bbe: But, brothers, take kindly the words which I have said for your profit; for I have not sent you a long letter.

verses.en: Know ye that our brother Timothy is set at liberty; with whom, if he come shortly, I will see you.
verses.pt: Sabei que o irmão Timóteo já está solto, com o qual, se ele vier brevemente, vos verei.
verses.en_web: Know that our brother Timothy has been freed, with whom, if he comes shortly, I will see you.
verses.en_bbe: Our brother Timothy has been let out of prison; and if he comes here in a short time, he and I will come to you together.

verses.en: Salute all them that have the rule over you, and all the saints. They of Italy salute you.
verses.pt: Saudai a todos os vossos guias e a todos os santos. Os de Itália vos saúdam.
verses.en_web: Greet all of your leaders and all the saints. The Italians greet you.
verses.en_bbe: Give words of love from me to those who are rulers over you, and to all the saints. Those who are in Italy send you their love.

verses.en: Grace be with you all. Amen.
verses.pt: A graça seja com todos vós.
verses.en_web: Grace be with you all. Amen.
verses.en_bbe: May grace be with you all.
